name: Biometrics
description: The device owner's confirmation through the system's dialog: Face ID / Touch ID (LocalAuthentication), the fingerprint or face of Android's BiometricPrompt, optionally the passcode / PIN in their place. A yes or no, not a key. No web half. The app's side is Biometrics.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: The app uses Face ID to confirm that it is you.
